original_benchmark.notes: Four subsets: gsm8k (400), math (1000), olympiadbench (1000), omnimath (1000). Original harness is direct vLLM generation with the critique prompt; the PRM path (run_eval_prm_rlhflow.py) and voting mode are not adapted.

harbor_adapter.notes: The adapter covers all 3,400 items and oracle verification passes all of them. Not yet published to the registry; all 3,400 tasks are planned for registration. Parity subset: 200 items (--split parity, 50 per subset, stratified by error/correct, seed 42), codex@0.161.0 with gpt-5.6-terra, 3 runs per side. Average F1 78.48 ± 0.95 (original) vs 78.78 ± 0.38 (Harbor); run ranges overlap for all reported metrics. parity_costs is an approximate total (about $30) for both sides.
